Justification: names system calls as an event/opportunity at which the OS can schedule another process on the CPU (e.g., when a process blocks or yields via a system call).
points.partial_credit: Half if it only vaguely says 'other events' or 'when a process gives up the CPU' without naming system calls or a specific event.

points.description: Adds that various other events (e.g., I/O completion, process exit/blocking, other interrupts) also give the OS chances to perform scheduling.

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a correct justification naming system calls (or an equivalent event such as a process blocking, yielding or exiting) as scheduling opportunities. Give part marks for TRUE with a vague justification. If the answer is FALSE or has no justification, give 0, since the question says no correct justification means no marks.
